title: Math Challenge
tagline: From counting ducks to algebraic topology.
description: A math challenge game from age 4 to professional mathematician, in seven locales. Practice is free forever, and we publish the research behind every decision.
intro: A math challenge game spanning ages 4 to professional mathematician. A parent registers and creates profiles for their children; an adaptive placement test sets the difficulty while age sets the visual theme. Two separate axes, deliberately.
how: Challenges are built from an item bank and scored server-side. Larry, the orange rhino, explains what went right and where the reasoning went off track — like a patient professor, never like an examiner.
p1: Practice is free forever. We never charge a child for doing mathematics.
p2: A child is never a user — only a profile inside a parent's account.
p3: Never camera, microphone, or biometrics. For anyone, at any tier.
p4: A screen-time limit never breaks a streak.
p5: Larry never shames a child for being wrong.
research: Forty-seven studies, about 157,000 words, with cited sources and declared limitations — including the passages where the evidence contradicts this product.
status: In construction. No public release yet.
sponsor: A project by Ignia, running on Cloudflare.
